resources.string: Removes WeType\'s large-screen limits: keyboard width cap, single-hand mode gate, and a size-adjust panel that stays centred.
Force-stop and relaunch WeType so the hooks reload.
This force-stops com.tencent.wetype. Any text you were typing may be lost.
Raises the width ceiling on unfolded / landscape screens. The built-in size adjuster keeps its full travel.
WeType disables single-hand mode on large screens. Turn this on to force it, knowing the layout is designed for phone widths.

Free throughout the Alpha stage. Every feature is unlocked by default, and the code below is purely a tip jar that unlocks nothing. Charging for some features after a future Beta or stable release is not ruled out.
Donations are voluntary and give no extra features, no priority support and no licence. Thanks either way.
See whether the module is actually running inside WeType.

Your framework is older than libxposed API %1$d, so it does not load this module at all: LSPosed shows the switch as on and nothing happens. Update to LSPosed 2.2 or newer (or Vector 2.2+), then restart WeType.

If WeType has already been restarted and this is still empty, check two things: that the module is enabled in LSPosed with WeType in its scope, and that your LSPosed is 2.2 or newer (libxposed API %1$d) - an older framework refuses to load this module and says nothing about it.

The framework manager row asks whether the manager is installed as an app of its own. LSPosed\'s manager does not have to be installed to be opened - it ships with the framework module (there is a manager.apk inside the module directory), and the action button on the LSPosed module page in KernelSU opens it. So "no standalone app" here is not a fault: as long as the framework row above reads LSPosed, everything is in order.

WeType\'s keyboard process was already running when the module was installed, so the hooks never reached it. Force-stop WeType - “Restart WeType” on the settings page does it - and open its keyboard again.

Some hooks could not be installed. If you have just installed or updated this module, force-stop WeType once: the hooks are attached when its processes start, so a module updated while WeType was running only takes full effect after that. If this list survives the restart, this WeType build has most likely renamed the methods these hooks target, and the module needs an update.
This build targets WeType %1$s and this device runs %2$s. Hooks that address the host by its internal names may stay inactive.
WeType is not the current input method on this device.

The module\'s own most recent lines from inside WeType, oldest first. Refreshing asks the running module for a fresh copy, so no root is needed. Export writes them into one file together with this device\'s environment, ready to send.
